description: This is a server-side source file implementing a lightweight Express server that manages a Todo list through CRUD operations. It proxies requests to an SQLite database via HTTP endpoints, initializes the database schema if missing, and exposes REST API routes for health check, getting, creating, and deleting todos.

methods.name: getConfig()
methods.description: Returns configuration derived from environment variables, including the base URL for the SQLite service and the server port.

methods.name: createServer()
methods.description: Creates and configures an Express application with routes for health, fetching, adding, and deleting todos.

methods.name: sqliteExec(sql, params = [])
methods.description: A helper function that sends SQL commands via HTTP POST to the SQLite service router to perform database operations.

methods.name: ensureSchema()
methods.description: Ensures that the 'todos' table exists in the database, creating it if missing.
